answer: Weight is capacity that evaporates unless rebought: one ridge meters an operator’s shared timing and lets only one signal stream age into weight; every extra head under that operator halves all their lives, so keeping head k at full weight needs 2^k copper locked that epoch and forfeits old copper when the ridge folds clones. A lone newcomer locks 2 copper. n heads: 2^(n+1)-2 copper each epoch; split keys still share one ridge.
